# Fair Value

> Open-source (MIT) Python library, REST API and MCP server for financial valuation: 14 read-only, deterministic tools spanning 135 methods — DCF/NAV/CCA, cost of capital (WACC/CAPM), derivatives, credit risk, fixed income and structured products — aligned to IVS 2025 / IFRS.

## Connect

- Hosted MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP, no API key): https://fair-value.ascent-partners.com/mcp
- Hosted REST API: https://fair-value.ascent-partners.com/v1 (OpenAPI: https://fair-value.ascent-partners.com/v1/openapi.json)
- Local stdio server: `uvx --from 'fair-value[mcp]' fair-value-mcp` or `pip install 'fair-value[mcp]' && fair-value-mcp`
- Official MCP Registry name: `com.ascent-partners/fair-value`

## MCP tools

All tools are pure computation (no I/O), read-only and idempotent; a `method` parameter selects the formula inside each tool.

- `calculate_dcf`, `calculate_market_multiple`, `calculate_residual`, `calculate_sector_metrics`
- `calculate_discount_rate` (WACC/CAPM), `calculate_expected_value`
- `calculate_option`, `calculate_structured_product`, `calculate_convertible_bond`, `calculate_fixed_income`
- `calculate_credit_loss`, `calculate_fair_value_adjustment`, `calculate_actuarial_pv`, `calculate_loss_making_company`

## Docs

- Documentation: https://fair-value.ascent-partners.com/docs
- Method catalogue: https://fair-value.ascent-partners.com/v1/methods
